import os
folder='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
p=folder+'/task-75ede3be.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The grid is a periodic colored field with zero-valued occlusions.
    # Fill zeros from the five-column motif established by the visible cells
    # in the same row, extending the row pattern from either side.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    motif_colors = (3, 5, 7, 9, 1)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        known = [(c, v) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in motif_colors]
        if not known:
            continue
        # Determine the row's phase by fitting the repeating five-cell motif
        # to its visible cells. Keep the phase with the most agreements.
        best_phase = 0
        best_score = -1
        for phase in range(5):
            score = sum(v == motif_colors[(c - phase) % 5] for c, v in known)
            if score > best_score:
                best_score, best_phase = score, phase
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v == 0:
                out[r][c] = motif_colors[(c - best_phase) % 5]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print(p)
